notes.title: Join the Lombardi's World Discord Server!
notes.content:
Stuck in Lombardi's World? Wish you had friends that could play with you? Maybe someone that knows the tricks? Join the Discord server and find yourself a group to raid with or even enlist one of our Tour Guides to help walk you through your first run!

Join here: https://discord.gg/bGgzUVHKDP
